title: User's language preference is set to Spanish, but error messages are shown in English
description: In the user settings, the language is set to Spanish, and the user interface shows up in Spanish. However, when the user attempts to access a file they do not have permission to access, the error message is in English.

title: Update color pallette to have more contrast
description: It's hard to see the black text on the gray background.

title: Submitting form does not run on Firefox
description: Clicking the buttons to submit a form does not work on Firefox, even though following the same steps works on Google Chrome.

title: User opted into email alerts but does not receive an email
description: User settings have both email and text alerts on. When the complaint is updated, the user is receiving text messages but has not received any emails.

title: A non-admin user has access to the powers of an admin
description: A non-admin user sees the same display that an admin can see, and can see other users and the groups they are assigned to.

title: Text on the home page flows off the screen
description: The first paragraph under the title is cut off when the window size is too small.

title: Search function not displaying any results
description: Even when searching the titles of cases that appear in the database, they do not appear in the search bar.

title: Search function displaying all results, not just those that match the query
description: I searched "burglary" but got all 3123 results from the databased, not just those that match "burglary".

title: If user clicks back button in the middle of submitting a complaint, complaint is duplicated
description: I started a complaint but did not click all the way through to "Submit". Then I used the back button and then "Next" button and then "Submit". The complaint appeared twice in the database.

title: Add offine functionality
Audit trails for cases filed in February 2013 are missing
Heading on the home page is not centered
description: Headings on other pages are centered, so this should be consistent

title: New report confusing for citizen user
description: New users were shown the system but were not able to figure out how to make a report without instruction.

title: Audit trail does not keep track of unauthorized requests
description: Audit trail seems to only be showing requests that succeeded, not those that were rejected.

title: Text of reports is too small
description: Make the font size bigger or make the user be able to change the font size, as some users might find it hard to read.

title: Submission of complaint throws an error when back button is used
description: Clicked through the first two screens for making a complaint, then tried to go back to modify response on the first screen and got an error.

title: Images are not loading
description: Space is held for the images, but they are not showing up on any pages

title: Add email authorization
description: Beyond the user id and password, add authentication via email. Send a code or link via email to ensure the user is who they say they are.

title: Users cannot be part of more than one group
description: When admin tries to assign a user to a new group, it automatically removes them from the group they were already in.

title: Changes in configurations do not save if user logs out and logs back in
description: User logs in, moves the widgets around on their dashboard to meet their preferences, logs out, and then logs back in. The dashboard has reset to the default configuration.

title: Make it easier to navigate back to home screen
description: After completing a report, the user cannot easily get back to the home screen. There should be an obvious button for how to return home.

title: Inconsistent styling on profile page
description: The home page and profile pages have different fonts for headers, looks unprofessional.

title: Add single sign on
description: Make compatible with single sign on for use by organizations that already have a sign on system

title: Check text-only option
description: Check that the automatically generated versions of text without the stylesheets are still readable.

title: Submit button does not redirect
description: Clicking the submit button at the end of a report will enter into the database but does not redirect the user or provide any feedback that it worked.

title: Cases take a long time to load
description: Searching for a particular case will load eventually, but sometimes takes several minutes.

title: Cases not syncing between stations
description: Cases filed under the jurisdiction of one police station are not showing up for other stations.

title: Fix login
description: Users can bypass the login step by clicking login without entering anything into the fields, and access a blank public profile.

title: New report should be in new tab
description: Starting a new report should open a new tab so the user does not lose their place and can refer to information on the main pages.

title: Alerts don't disappear
description: Alerts in the Alerts tab get appended to but never go away, so the list grows indefinitely.
